name: Liquid Lsp
description: LSP integration for Shopify Liquid templates via the Shopify CLI theme language server.
longDescription: An LSP integration for Shopify themes: `.lsp.json` runs `shopify theme language-server` from the Shopify CLI (`npm install -g @shopify/cli`, or Homebrew's `shopify-cli`), mapping `.liquid` to `liquid` and `.json` to `json`, so Claude Code gets the theme language server's diagnostics and completions in Liquid templates and theme JSON. Ships only `plugin.json`, `.lsp.json` and a README. MIT.

license.note: No license text found upstream (searched the item directory and the repository root). plugin.json declares "MIT".
